The public ports in the actual composed apparatus are the fixed original X and
H ports, plus the four new Q ports. Assume only those specified raw records are
accessible, with the setting known as the chosen protocol parameter. The
original reset readiness, access restriction and clock convention remain
assumptions. A native readiness detector or clock is not silently included.

Fix any additional finite horizon B. Enlarge the torus sufficiently to prevent
wrap-around; for example side 16(S+B+10T)+1 suffices. Prepare independent uniform
current triples at

    M_j=(0,-j,0), N_j=(0,0,-9T-j),   1<=j<=P+B,
    F_(i,k)=Q_i+(S+k)e_y,            1<=k<=B, i=X,Y,R,Z.

These coordinates are outside the ready cones and distinct from the control
pulses and source encodings. They are independent of the masks and lower seeds.
No fresh coordinates are inserted during the run.

M_j and N_j first reach the original X and H ports respectively at T+j. The
F_(i,k) block first reaches its own Q_i at S+k. It cannot reach any public port
earlier than that time. At equal time there are just two cross-edges among
these new ports: F_Y can affect Q_X, and F_R can affect Q_X. Order the four
ports Y,R,Z,X to make those edges triangular.

All other cross-arrivals occur later. In particular, old-frontier arrivals at
new ports and new-frontier arrivals at original ports have positive delays
when P>0. The old X/H cross-delays are 7T and 9T. At a given global tick an
ordering old-X,H,Y,R,Z,X works for the streams that have begun.

For each newly arriving extreme axial triple, the path to its own port is
unique. Conditional on earlier blocks and the complementary initial fields,
that output is a composition of H permutations and XOR translations in that
new triple. It is therefore a permutation. Chronological triangularity gives

## 5. Complete public record, joint independence, and failures

Keep the predecessor's six designated public ports through tick R and add the
new herald port, including its whole raw prefix. The outgoing q_Y,q_R,q_Z ports
remain private until a specified terminal read. No internal seed, key, or old
carrier register is added to the observer's access class.

Neither new pulse can reach an old public port by R; its nearest such arrival
is at S+2d=R+d. The remote herald/Z sources are farther still. The reserved old
and selector public-frontier triples remain outside every new private ready
cone and outside the remote cones. Thus their conditional independence survives
the extra readiness constraints.

The preceding chronological-bijection proof consequently gives the same joint
uniform law for all old public noise records: probability factor 2^(-6P-18d),
independent of the old and new seeds, input, selected deadline record, and new
private outputs. At the selector deadline the three unselected ciphertexts are
independent fair bits conditional on x and the hidden carrier. They are also
independent of the six new reset seeds.

Conditioning on G changes the distribution of u,v exactly as specified above;
it does not create a correlation with those old public records. This proves
the joint factorization in section 1. It is stronger than separately correct
public and carrier marginals.

Let T,P,S=T+P,d,R=S+d be the actual native-X parameters, with d=68 and
T=185, and retain the actual initial preparation and ready cones. Let qG be
the new herald position (12R,0,0). Fix B with 1 <= B <= R before preparation.
Retain the original six public positions in this order:

    p0=(0,T,0), p1=(0,0,-8T),
    p2=(T,P,0), p3=(-T,P,0), p4=(4T,P,0), p5=(0,S,0).

At initial tick zero supply independent uniform triples at the following new
coordinates for each t=R+1,...,R+B:

    f0(t)=(0,T-t,0),
    f1(t)=(0,0,-8T-t),
    fi(t)=pi+t e_y, i=2,3,4,5,
    f6(t)=(12R-t,0,0).

All these blocks are independent of the original apparatus, seed correlations,
prior frontier bank, and input. They replace only previously unconstrained
initial coordinates. No additional cold pins or mid-run preparation are used.
Use a sufficiently large torus; the previous choice 64R+64T+1 suffices for
this extension through 2R.
